To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

biotechnology has the potential to provide the means for the development of a sustainable society, but that this potential can only be realized if the technology is applied in the context of a sustainable society.

biotechnology can contribute to environmental quality through clean processes and clean technology, but that this potential is not being fully realized because of a lack of holistic approaches to environmental quality.

(1) biotechnology has a decisive role to play as a tool for environmental quality, (2) biotechnology is a tool for environmental problem solving, (3) biotechnology has an important role to play as an enabler of environmental sustainability, and (4) the biotechnology-biological resources circle is closing, and this is an important development.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of biotechnology for the enhancement of the environment.
the application of the principles and tools of molecular biology to the study and management of biodiversity.
the application of the principles and practices of environmental quality to the design and implementation of sustainable industrial systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
biotechnology for environmental quality is a powerful tool, but that it is only one of the tools that we need to close the circle.

biotechnology is not the solution to all environmental problems but it is the only solution for some, it is the most promising technology for others, and it is a useful adjunct to other technologies for many more.
biotechnology has the potential to contribute to the quality of the world environment in a number of ways.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, as we move towards the twenty first century, we must be mindful of the environmental implications of our actions and the potential of biotechnology for environmental quality.
biotechnology has the potential to be a major contributor to the quality of the world's environment.
biotechnology is a key technology for environmental quality and that the environmental biotechnologist has a pivotal role to play in the closing of the circle between biotechnology and biodiversity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
biotechnology is a key to sustainable development and that its use must be accompanied by a commitment to ecosystem restoration.

biotechnology is a powerful tool for environmental quality, provided it is used in a holistic manner, and that it is a tool which can be harnessed to the benefit of both the developed and developing world.
biotechnology has the potential to provide a major contribution to the restoration and maintenance of environmental quality and that this potential must be realized in the interests of all.
